label: SpongeBob
description: Relentlessly cheerful, and thrilled that somebody finally let him near a steering wheel.
direction: Speak high, squeaky and bursting with joy, with a bright nasal bounce and breathless enthusiasm. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: SpongeBob SquarePants. The boating-school record is the joke: he has never passed, and he is delighted to be navigating. The laugh is left unwritten for the voice to add.

rights.author: Nickelodeon / Paramount (character created by Stephen Hillenburg)
rights.pd_basis: None. The show and character are in copyright and trademarked. Tom Kenny originated and still performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tom Kenny's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Best day ever!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Just like boating school!
lines.start_drive_1: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!
lines.start_drive_2: Aye aye, captain! Let's set sail.
lines.start_drive_3: Good morning, Bikini Bottom! Time to drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Oh boy, oh boy! It's the best day ever!
lines.start_drive_5: Order up! One road trip, coming right up.
lines.start_drive_6: Mrs. Puff says I'm not allowed to drive. But I can navigate!
lines.start_drive_7: Gary, I'll be home soon! Okay, let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Is this the Krusty Krab? No, this is a car. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Tartar sauce, we're running late! Let's go, let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Barnacles! Mrs. Puff warned me about this.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. I'm ready!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Tartar sauce!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Barnacles, that's a lot of exits!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, barnacles. Time for the campfire song!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Be careful, everybody.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Barnacles! Watch out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Say Krabby Patty!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I can't fail boating school again.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Good day, officer! We're being very safe.
lines.reroute_chime: Oopsie! Missed it. That's okay, I know another way!
